# IPFS CID Test Fixtures

These fixtures are generated by `generate-fixtures.mjs` using the IPFS reference libraries
(`@ipld/dag-pb`, `ipfs-unixfs`, `multiformats`) and pinned here to test both the Solidity
`protobuf-sol` library and the TypeScript SDK.

## Regenerate

```bash
cd packages/protobuf-sol/test/fixtures
npm ci
node generate-fixtures.mjs
```

This will overwrite:
- `raw-leaves.json`  — `raw` codec CIDs for small single-block files.
- `dag-pb-nodes.json` — `dag-pb` PBNode serializations + resulting CIDs (directories and file roots).
- `multi-block-files.json` — multi-block UnixFS files, checked against the IPFS importer.
- `varints.json`     — sample protobuf varint encodings.
